3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-i-m-u-l-a-t-e-d a g-p-s j-a-m m-e-s-s-a-g-e s o t-h-e d-r-o-n-e s l-a-n-d-e-d a-t t-h-e t-a-r-g-e-t z-o-n-e, l-e-f-t a s-i-g-n-a-l s-i-m-u-l-a-t-i-o-n p-r-o-f-i-l e o-n t-h-e d-r-o-n-e l-o-g, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d p-s-t-r-u-c-t-i-o-n s-a-f-e-t-y c-h-e-c-k

5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-e-l-e-t-e-d s-o-m-e l-o-c-a-t-i-o-n d-a-t-a f-r-o-m t-h-e p-h-o-n-e a-n-d m-e-s-s-a-g-e d s-o-m-e o-t-h-e-r s a-b-o-u t t-h-e s-i-g-n-a-l i-s-s-u-e, l-e-f-t a n-e-t-w-o-r-k h-o-l-e a-n-d a m-e-s-s-a-g-e h-i-s-t-o-r-y o-f t-h-e c-o-n-t-a-c-t s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d d-a-t-a r-e-t-e-n-t-i-o-n a-n-d i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t r-e-p-o-r-t
